function strs<T extends object>(o: T) {
  const r = {} as { [K in keyof T]: string };
  for (const k in o) {
    r[k] = String(o[k]);
  }
  return r;
}
console.log(strs({ a: 1, b: true }));

function keysOf<T extends { a: number }>(o: T): (keyof T)[] {
  const keys: (keyof T)[] = [];
  for (const k in o) {
    const key: keyof T = k;
    keys.push(key);
  }
  return keys;
}
console.log(keysOf({ a: 1, b: 2 }));

function total<K extends string>(o: Record<K, number>): number {
  let sum = 0;
  for (const k in o) {
    const key: K = k;
    sum += o[key];
  }
  return sum;
}
console.log(total({ x: 1, y: 2 }));
